identifier: Every number dino-autofocus carries in its code constants, configuration files and run records, as imported whole into microscope_agent/autofocus/ by the subtree merge 8f947892a34ec1e8aa114431d95c3881b14b136a (card 071) at dino main 95eee9582a820ebf09896cf53db2e28cd3ed5397, ruled one by one for task 052. The row-level table is kb/staging/dino_autofocus_number_inventory.v0.json.
grade_rule: Anything dino recorded would enter as prior_run:dino-autofocus@95eee95 at E3 at most (10.3 rule 1), even when taken on this stand: a run recorded in another repository is not a run of this system. A vendor or literature figure quoted in dino enters only from the document itself, never as dino's.
how_it_was_reached: The person decided on 2026-10-15 to move all of dino-autofocus here and freeze it there; the code crossed whole, and the ruling condition applies to numbers and safety values only (task 052). Read only, from the imported tree in this working copy.
transferred_note: No number entered. Every measurement dino recorded that the store lacks is one of dino's first 20 question cards, whose rulings stand in kb/staging/dino_autofocus_first_questions.v0.json and are cited, not re-ruled: the 4x stage-to-camera calibration (L-032), the 4x-to-100x parfocal offset (L-033), the 2026-09-30 12-bit readout (L-056) and the dark offset (L-057) all wait on the person, so they stay gaps.
agreed_with_the_store: 101 rows: the objectives' NA and working distances, the sensor pitch, the read noise, the QE at 600 nm, the pixel-size presets, the coverslip thickness, the camera serials, the 16-bit ceiling and the focus-hold readings, each citing its entry
conflict_note: Kept, not merged (rule 7). Two kinds: (1) the configs' immersion index 1.518, which matches one reseller and not the bench bottle's printed nD 1.5150; (2) the configs' 'illumination.wavelength 0.605' and 40 nm band, which read this bench's path NAME '605' as a wavelength -- the filter is 595/31 (L-052, answered 2026-10-15). Plus one configuration comment that only the 20x pixel size is measured, which the person contradicted on 2026-10-15 (051).
